command: set -e; python /runner/probe.py; python -m pip install --no-deps --no-build-isolation -e .; python /runner/check_compiled.py; set +e; python /runner/native.py; quote_native_status=$?; python /runner/native_reviewed.py; quote_reviewed_status=$?; test "$quote_native_status" -eq 0 && test "$quote_reviewed_status" -eq 0

cgroup_before.memory.events:
low 0
high 0
max 0
oom 0
oom_kill 0
oom_group_kill 0

cgroup_after.memory.events:
low 0
high 0
max 0
oom 0
oom_kill 0
oom_group_kill 0
